source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of carboxylic acids (PDF 108).

blocks.text: Carboxylic acids aise organic compounds hain jin mein carboxyl functional group, -COOH, ho; aam formula RCOOH hai. Aam misalein methanoic acid (formic acid, cheentiyon mein), ethanoic acid (acetic acid, sirke mein) aur butanoic acid (butyric acid, basi makhan mein) hain.

blocks.alt: Aam banawat R-C(=O)-OH, label carboxylic acids.
blocks.caption: Carboxylic acids ki aam banawat (kitab ke PDF safha 108 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Chhote carboxylic acids kamre ke darja hararat par oonche ubalne ke darjon wale maaye hain, kyunke in ke molecules hydrogen bonds banate hain; ethanoic acid ke molecules hydrogen bond wale joron (dimers) mein jurte hain. Ethanoic acid 17 C par pighalta aur 118 C par ubalta hai. Is ka pighalne ka darja kamre ke darje ke qareeb hai, is liye sardiyon mein jam jata hai; khalis ethanoic acid ki thos shakal glacial acetic acid kehlati hai kyunke yeh glacier jaisi dikhti hai. Paani se hydrogen bonds banane ki wajah se chhote tezaab, methanoic aur ethanoic acid, paani mein ghulte hain.

blocks.alt: Ethanoic acid ke do molecules, H3C-C(=O)-OH aur HO-C(=O)-CH3, aik ring mein aamne saamne. Har aik ka C=O oxygen (delta-) doosre ke O-H hydrogen (delta+) se dash wale hydrogen bond se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Hydrogen bonding se banne wali acetic acid ki dimeric (jore wali) shakal (kitab ke PDF safha 108 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har molecule ka C=O oxygen (delta-) doosre molecule ke O-H hydrogen (delta+) ko kheenchta hai, is liye do hydrogen bonds (dash wali lakeerein) do molecules ko aik jora (dimer) bana dete hain. Isi wajah se ethanoic acid ka ubalne ka darja ooncha hai. Kitab ke label mein 'Dimeric from' chhapa hai; sahi 'Dimeric form' hai.

Lambi zanjeer wale aliphatic monocarboxylic acids fatty acids kehlate hain. Stearic, palmitic aur oleic acids nabati teilon mein triglycerides ki shakal mein hain; palmitic acid, C16H32O2, palm oil mein bari miqdar mein hai. Fatty acids apni lambi hydrophobic (paani se door bhagne wali) alkyl zanjeeron ki wajah se paani mein nahi ghulte.

blocks.prompt: Ethanoic acid ka ubalne ka darja ethanal se kaheen zyada kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid ke molecules apne -OH aur C=O groups se hydrogen bonds (dimers) banate hain; ethanal mein O-H nahi aur yeh khud se hydrogen bond nahi bana sakta.

items: Carboxylic acids: RCOOH; maslan methanoic, ethanoic, butanoic acids.
Hydrogen bond wale dimers: oonche ubalne ke darje; chhote tezaab paani mein ghulte.
Fatty acids: lambi zanjeerein, paani mein na ghulne wale.
